buyer.mention: iPhone 16 Pro and iPhone 16 Pro Max

excerpt: Apple today introduced iPhone 16 Pro and iPhone 16 Pro Max, featuring Apple Intelligence, larger display sizes, new creative capabilities with innovative pro camera features, stunning graphics for immersive gaming, and more — all powered by the A18 Pro chip.
notes: Press release states the iPhones are powered by the A18 Pro chip; it does not use the words 'designed by Apple' in this passage. A18 Pro is Apple's in-house SoC (mapped to apple-silicon).
